systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts, ministère de l'économie, des finances et du budget
systems.tiers: National: every natural or legal person on the territory, required for all economic formalities and transactions

note: Décret 2004-469 institutes the NIU as the compulsory taxpayer registration number and its database; a tax register, classed with the out-of-scope registers as the decree describes it (a taxpayer immatriculation, not identity enrolment). The only civil-status mention is a copy of a birth act in a bureau-de-change licence file under the companion Décret 2004-468. Nothing on civil registration offices.
